messages:
Eli (Support): Escalating Novapulse trial account. Okta SSO completes but embed ingest returns 403. Renewal window in 9 days, marked high priority. :rotating_light:
Harper (CS): Ack — can you paste the minimal repro and any error output here? I'll prepare a comms plan and capture owner info.
Eli (Support): Repro below, failure reproducible on prod and staging.
```
POST /auth/callback 302 -> /app
GET /embed/ingest 403 {"error":"forbidden", "reason":"tenant_mapping_missing"}
```
Eli (Support): Config: tenant=novapulse-trial, region=eu-west-1, SSO=Okta. Tried key rotation and cache flush, no change.
Ravi (Eng): Looking. Noticed tenant-router had a deploy ~2h ago. Pulling router logs now. :mag:
Zoe (Solutions): Draft comms plan suggestion: (1) immediate ack + 30m ETA for root cause; (2) share manual mapping workaround for quick unblock; (3) offer enablement + feedback session to de-risk renewal; (4) temporarily mark renewal as "under review" until CS sync. I'll draft language.
Harper (CS): Good. Eli  share account owner's timezone and preferred contact method so I can schedule the handoff.
Eli (Support): Owner is @maria.novapulse, CET. I scheduled a placeholder sync for 16:00 CET and let them know we're investigating.
deploy-bot: deploy-start tenant-router-hotfix 1729981450
Ravi (Eng): Found the regression in tenant-router mapping when tenant IDs include dash suffixes. Hotfix branch built, running tests (~12m).
Zoe (Solutions): I'll include the manual mapping steps in the customer note so they can unblock immediately if they want to. KB ref: https://redwood.internal/kb/tenant-router#manual-map
deploy-bot: deploy-succeeded tenant-router-hotfix 1729981522
Ravi (Eng): Verified post-deploy: repro no longer returns 403 for novapulse-trial. Auth -> embed flow completes in tests.
Harper (CS): Great. I'll confirm with Maria and propose the enablement session to capture feedback and ensure the trial is renewal-ready. Temporarily removing the "at-risk" flag pending the session outcome.
Eli (Support): Closing the support ticket and forwarding follow-up items to CS (enablement invite, post-call summary, renewal review).
Zoe (Solutions): I'll send the enablement invite and include: timeline of events, workaround steps, and the patched commit id. I'll also add a brief survey link to capture immediate feedback after the session.
Harper (CS): Assigning action items: 1) Enablement session owner: Zoe; 2) Customer-facing summary + technical notes: Ravi; 3) Renewal outcome review in 7 days: Harper. Adding a CRM note and survey plan. :white_check_mark:
Eli (Support): Thanks team  good cross-team response.
Harper (CS): I'll update the account record and add the follow-up tasks. Closing this thread for support; CS will follow the comm plan and capture feedback for renewal playbook improvements.
